{{Top|ga}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:WhatsBotheringRashi.png]] |name=Rashi |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes= |skin=Brown |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Honor guard (Ferrix)|Honor guard]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Hey Brasso, let's go!|Rashi to Brasso|audio=Rashi-Brasso-Andor1.flac|{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}}}} '''Rashi''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who lived and worked on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] as a [[Grappler (profession)|grappler]] in a salvage yard. In [[5 BBY]], Rashi was present in the salvage yard when a team of [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] [[Tac-Corpo|Corpos]] arrived on Ferrix. Rashi was also involved in the [[funeral]] for [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]] as a member of Ferrix's [[Honor guard (Ferrix)|honor guard]] as well as posing as his coworker [[Brasso]] in order to trick the [[Imperial Security Bureau]], which at the [[time]] was keeping tabs on him while searching for Andor's son, [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian]]. The funeral ultimately broke out into an anti–[[Galactic Empire]] [[Ferrix Riot|riot]], in which Rashi participated. ==Biography== {{Quote|Haven't seen any blues in a while.''"
"''What the hell are they doin'?''"
"''Hunting for somebody.|Rashi and a coworker discuss the arrival of the corpos|audio=Rashi-Corpos-Andor3.flac|{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}}}} [[File:RashiWorking-Andor3.png|thumb|left|300px|Rashi worked as a grappler on Ferrix.]] Rashi was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who worked with fellow [[Grappler (profession)|grappler]] [[Brasso]] on the [[planet]] [[Ferrix]] at a salvage yard. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|101}} while about to go to work, Rashi chatted with Brasso on the way there. Brasso was then stopped by his friend [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and began conversing with him; bothered by this delay, Rashi called for him to come and board the tram to depart. Shortly after, Rashi was working at the salvage yard when Andor came to again talk with Brasso. While working, [[North Team]], a team of [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] [[Tac-Corpo|Corpos]], arrived on Ferrix on board a [[RK-392 mobile tac-pod|Mobile Tac-Pod]]. Rashi noted that he had not seen Corpos in a while and speculated that they were hunting for someone. Later, when North Team prompted an alarm in the town, Rashi and his fellow grapplers moved into action. [[Standard week|Weeks]] later, Cassian's [[Parent|mother]], [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]], [[Death|died]] after suffering from an illness. Rashi accompanied Brasso to her [[Andor household|house]] in order to help the [[Daughters of Ferrix]] organization clean up and remove her body. Rashi walked alongside them as they exited and later returned to the house, where the Andors' [[droid]], [[B2EMO]], was pleased that he had come back. His return prompted the undercover [[Imperial Security Bureau]] agent [[Corv]] to call for patrols to keep watch on the house{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} as he thought it had been Brasso, whom he described as the "big man" and hoped to capture for information on Cassian. When Rashi emerged from the house the next [[Standard day|day]], Corv, upon inspecting the man closer, realized that he was not Brasso and he had been tricked, alerting a guard and asking for the manhunt to continue. [[File:Rashi-RixRoad.png|thumb|right|300px|Rashi (middle) exits the Andor household.]] Later that day, Rashi was a part of the [[Honor guard (Ferrix)|honor guard]] that marched down [[Rix Road]] during Andor's [[Maarva's funeral procession|funeral]], stopping at [[Fountain Square]]. Prior to her death, Andor had made a [[Hologram|holographic]] message speaking out against the [[Galactic Empire]] that was played at the funeral; the message caused the procession to break out into a [[Ferrix Riot|riot]] against the occupying [[Ferrix garrison|Imperial garrison]], in which Rashi participated and helped multiple individuals who had been injured. This included the human [[Wilmon Paak]]—who had increased the riot's violence by detonating a homemade [[pipe bomb]]—whom Rashi and Brasso brought to safety away from the riot; Rashi supported Paak with one [[Limb|arm]] while carrying Andor's [[funerary stone]] under his other. Brasso and Paak subsequently fled Ferrix without Rashi. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|That's not him.''"
"''Sir?''"
"''The big man. We've been played.|Corv and a guard discuss Rashi pretending to be Brasso|audio=Corv-BigMan-Andor12.flac|}} Rashi had [[Color|black]] [[hair]], a beard, and brown skin. Corv considered him to be big in size, initially mistaking him for Brasso. ==Equipment== [[File:RashiFuneral-Andor12.png|thumb|left|300px|Rashi wore an honor guard uniform at Maarva Andor's funeral.]] Rashi's work [[Clothing|attire]] included orange pants and an orange shirt that he sometimes covered with a white vest. While working, he wore a yellow [[helmet]]. Rashi's non-work clothes included light brown shoes, striped blue pants, an orange shirt with a yellow stripe down the sleeves, and a green [[hat]]. He also had several tools ready to be used at his waist. At Maarva Andor's funeral, Rashi wore the red uniform of an honor guard with black pants and [[boot]]s. ==Behind the scenes== Rashi first appeared in "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," the first episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''{{'s}} [[Andor Season 1|first season]], which was released on [[September 21]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} He was portrayed by [[Victor Perez]]. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Rashi|soundcat=Audio files of Rashi}} *{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} {{1st}} *{{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} *{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} *{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Rashi |es=Rashi |fr=Rashi |ja=ラシ |ka=რაში }} [[Category:Ferrixians]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
